title: Sirmione 4K Walking Tour — Lake Garda's Peninsula Town, Italy 🇮🇹

This 5.5-mile walk covers all of it — the old town piazzas, the lakefront and beaches, Jamaica Beach's rock shelves, the Grotte di Catullo Roman villa, and a full castle tour — with parking, train, through northern Italy. The Romans built grand holiday villas here — the most impressive of which, the Grotte di Catullo, still stands at the tip of the promontory and ranks as one of the largest Roman residential sites in all of northern Italy. In the 13th century, the Della Scala (Scaligeri) family of Verona built the Rocca Scaligera — a rare lake fortress with its own port — which still guards the only land entrance to the old town. The name Sirmione itself likely derives from the Latin "syrma," meaning a long trailing garment — a fitting description for this slender peninsula trailing into the lake.  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📽 MORE WALKING TOURS ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🎄Christmas Markets Playlist: (https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSOO4vYXpMCd2nqHyPaDtgxkf_BsAuQCt&si=0YU1zhv0tLbwm8u6) 🍕 Italy Playlist: (https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSOO4vYXpMCc6k7EuMhr764qCNeXDrxpj&si=aYfLAtNw1eGc560w) 🚴 Biking Tours Playlist: (https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSOO4vYXpMCe4SaQXMk9IMfpkl1w473Zz&si=1rFBHTnZtCMmykPA) 🌍 Complete List of Walks: http://www.prowalks.com/videos   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📢 SUPPORT & CONNECT 📢 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🌍 Website: https://www.prowalktours.com 📧 Email: info@prowalktours.com 🔔 Subscribe for more! title: Otranto, Italy 4K Walking Tour | Beautiful Old Town & Turquoise Sea
description: This 4K walking tour of Otranto, Italy was filmed on Sunday, July 19th, 2026 starting at 12:34 PM at the Spiaggetta del Molo, the little beach at the foot of the town walls. It was a hot market Sunday — 31°C (88°F), with the monthly Otranto Antiqua antiques market running all day along the waterfront — so the whole town was either at the beach or in the water. The 5 km (3 mile) route circles the beaches, the walled old town, the Cathedral with its famous 12th-century Tree of Life floor mosaic and the Chapel of the 800 Martyrs, the Aragonese Castle, the Byzantine church of San Pietro, and ends on the long sandy beaches across the bay. Otranto is the easternmost town in Italy — on a clear day you can see Albania across the strait. I first filmed Otranto back in 2021, and this summer I finally brought my family here to swim. You will see them a few times during the walk. :)  Watch the original 2021 tour here: https://youtu.be/SWDsHlHmnY4 An evening walking tour of Otranto is coming soon to the channel!  For the best experience, be sure to turn on closed captions [CC] and wear headphones 🎧 as you watch this tour. title: Venice, Italy Ultimate Walking Tour – Rialto, San Marco & Historic Venice | 4K 60fps
description: Venice Ultimate walking tour — Part 1 of a 7-hour walk through the historic center of Venice, Italy, starting at the Rialto Bridge and covering the Fish Market, Piazza San Marco, the Bridge of Sighs, Campo Santi Giovanni e Paolo, and countless hidden campos and canals off the tourist path. Filmed in 4K60fps with binaural audio.  Venice was built on 118 small islands in a saltwater lagoon and has been a UNESCO World Heritage site since 1987. This walk begins near the Rialto Bridge — completed in 1591 by Antonio da Ponte — and spends nearly 4 hours through the labyrinthine alleys, hidden campos, and working neighborhoods of San Marco, Castello, and Cannaregio.  Ideal for virtual travel, treadmill walks, and ambient atmosphere. Best with headphones.  ⭐ Don't miss: Rialto Bridge at 4:38, the Fish Market at 33:35, the Scenic Rooftop Terrace at 58:26, Piazza San Marco at 1:31:55, St. Mark's Campanile view at 1:41:17, the Bridge of Sighs at 2:03:52, the Amazing Book Store (Libreria Acqua Alta) at 2:47:26, and the grocery store inside an old theater at 3:49:12.  📅 Filmed on: Saturday, July 2nd, 2022 at 10:50 AM 🌞 Weather: 32°C | 90°F 📍 Location: Venice, Veneto Region, Italy 🗺️ Map of the Walk: https://www.google.com/maps/d/edit?mid=14X7n1movkk-1Sko5mBbcqGDKb5T46zI&usp=sharing  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⏱️ TOUR TIMELINE ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 0:00 Intro and Map ⭐ 4:38 Rialto Bridge and Canal Walk 26:58 Venetian Mask Shop ⭐ 33:35 Fish Market 44:22 Campo Erberia 51:56 Rialto Bridge ⭐ 58:26 Scenic Rooftop Terrace 1:16:25 San Salvador Church ⭐ 1:31:55 Piazza San Marco ⭐ 1:41:17 St. Mark's Campanile View ⭐ 2:03:52 Bridge of Sighs 2:04:33 Waterfront Walk 2:15:00 Hidden Heart 2:26:10 Campo San Zaccaria 2:28:39 Campo Santi Filippo e Giacomo 2:29:59 Ponte de Canonica 2:34:36 Calle Larga S. title: 🇮🇹 Sirmione, Lake Garda Italy: The Town That Made Me Forget Everything Else!
description: Beneath this tiny Italian town, 70°C Roman springs still flow — and opera legend Maria Callas once called it home.  Join me on a walk through Sirmione, one of the most charming towns on Lake Garda — Italy's largest lake. We'll cross the drawbridge into the medieval Castello Scaligero, wander the narrow pedestrianised streets lined with cafés and flowers, cool off by the water, and soak up centuries of Roman and medieval history packed into this tiny peninsula.  🏰 A few facts about Sirmione: Sirmione sits on a narrow, 4 km peninsula jutting into Lake Garda — some say its name comes from the Greek word "syrma," meaning "tail," a nod to its elongated shape. The Castello Scaligero was built in the 13th–14th century by the Della Scala family, who ruled Verona for over a century, and it's the only medieval castle in Italy with its own harbour still enclosed within the walls. Beneath the town, sulphurous thermal springs rise from the lake bed at around 70°C — the same waters the Romans once used, and which still feed Sirmione's spas today. The town was also home to the legendary opera singer Maria Callas, and its historic centre is entirely pedestrianised, so the only way to see it properly is on foot — exactly what we're doing today.   🎬 Filming Info: 📍 Location: Sirmione, Italy 🇮🇹 📽️ Format: 4K HDR at 60fps 🎧 Audio: Real city sounds – no music, no commentary ☀️ Time: Daytime  👉 If you enjoyed this walk through Sirmione, please like and subscribe for more relaxing 4K walking tours from beautiful destinations across Italy and beyond. 💬 Which spot would you visit first — the castle, the cafés, or the lake? An ancient stone bridge offering picturesque views of the canals and traditional Suzhou architecture. 19. **Suzhou Pingtan Museum:** A museum dedicated to the traditional Suzhou performing art of Pingtan, featuring music, storytelling, and opera. 20. **Beisi Pagoda:** A historic pagoda offering stunning views of Suzhou and its surrounding landscapes. title: UPDATE! Universal Orlando Resort! CityWalk And Halloween Horror Nights!
description: **Universal Orlando Resort** is a major theme park destination in Orlando, Florida, featuring four parks: **Universal Studios Florida**, **Islands of Adventure**, the newer **Epic Universe** (opened 2025), and the water park **Volcano Bay**.  ### Parks Overview - **Universal Studios Florida**: Movie-themed with Diagon Alley (Harry Potter), Minion Land, Hollywood themes. Key rides: Harry Potter and the Escape from Gringotts, Transformers, Revenge of the Mummy. - **Islands of Adventure**: Adventure-focused with Hogsmeade (Harry Potter), Marvel Super Hero Island, Jurassic Park, Toon Lagoon. Highlights: Hagrid’s Magical Creatures Motorbike Adventure, The Incredible Hulk Coaster, Jurassic World VelociCoaster. - **Epic Universe**: Newest park with Ministry of Magic (Harry Potter), Isle of Berk (How to Train Your Dragon), Dark Universe, Celestial Park, and Super Nintendo World. Standouts: Stardust Racers, other high-thrill coasters. - **Volcano Bay**: Tropical water park with slides, lazy river, wave pool. Note: Seasonal closures (e.g., after Oct 2026) and cashless.  **Wizarding World of Harry Potter** spans lands in all three dry parks—Park-to-Park access is essential for full experience (Hogwarts Express connects USF & IOA).  ### Tickets & Practical Info (2026) - **Multi-day tickets** recommended: 3+ day Park-to-Park now includes Epic Universe hopping. Deals like "Buy 3 Get 2 Free" often available. - **Universal Express** skips lines (Unlimited with some on-site hotels; note exclusions like Hagrid’s after July 2026). - **On-site hotels** (11 options): Early Park Admission (1 hour), free transport (walking, water taxi, buses), some include Express. Tiers from Value to Signature (e.g., Hard Rock). - **CityWalk**: Free entertainment/dining/shopping hub.  ### Tips - Stay on-site for perks. Buy tickets in advance. Use app for mobile ordering, wait times. - Best times: Weekdays, avoid peak holidays. Plan for crowds in new Epic Universe. - 3+ days ideal; prioritize rope drop or Express for thrill rides. - Special events: Mardi Gras, Halloween Horror Nights, Holidays.  **Budget note**: Multi-day trip for family of 4 can be $5k+ including hotel/tickets (varies). title: 🇬🇧 LONDON WALK 🔥 37°C in CROWDED Central London! Oxford Street, Soho & Covent Garden | 4K
description: 🇬🇧 London Walk | London Heatwave 2026 | Oxford Street | 37°C in London | West End Walk | 4K. Join me on a London walking tour during the 5th heatwave of the summer, with temperatures reaching 37°C!  I start this walk on Oxford Street, one of London’s most famous and busiest shopping streets, before heading towards Tottenham Court Road and into the heart of Soho. From there, I continue through Chinatown, Leicester Square and finally into beautiful Covent Garden.  I chose to start on Oxford Street because I could take the air-conditioned Elizabeth line all the way to Bond Street, giving me a much-needed cool start before heading out into the heat. As I walk through central London, the sun is behind me, so thankfully it isn't beating directly into my face while I'm walking.  Along the way, I pass some of London's most popular areas for visitors:  📍 Oxford Street – One of the world's most famous shopping streets, packed with major stores, restaurants and shoppers.  📍 Tottenham Court Road – A major central London street connecting Oxford Street with Soho and known for shopping, restaurants and its excellent transport connections.  📍 Soho – One of London's liveliest neighbourhoods, famous for its restaurants, bars, nightlife, independent shops and colourful streets.  📍 Chinatown – London's vibrant Chinatown, filled with Chinese restaurants, bakeries, shops and the famous Chinatown Gate.  📍 Leicester Square – One of London's major entertainment hubs, surrounded by cinemas, theatres, restaurants and attractions. It's also right next to the famous West End.  📍 Covent Garden – One of London's most popular tourist destinations, known for its beautiful market buildings, street performers, restaurants, shops and lively atmosphere.  And the journey home turned into another adventure! 😅 On the way back, we got stuck inside Russell Square station for around 20 minutes because the train ahead of us had broken down. With the heat outside, the temperature inside the station quickly became uncomfortable and everyone was sweating while waiting for the train to move again.  This was the 5th heatwave of the summer, making this another very hot day for exploring London on foot. title: I Stayed In A Deserted Resort In America
description: I stayed overnight at Primm Valley Resort & Casino, a once-popular destination located in the middle of the Nevada desert, just outside Las Vegas. Once a popular stop for travellers heading to and from Las Vegas, the resort today feels very different from its heyday. In this video, I check into the hotel, explore the casino, tour the property and show you exactly what it's like staying here  With huge empty parking lots, quiet hallways and barely another guest in sight, this enormous resort felt frozen in time. Despite still being open,  the resort was incredibly quiet during my stay, and at times it almost felt deserted. With huge parking lots, long corridors and very few people around, it certainly wasn't what I expected.  *One week after this video was filmed, Primm was saved from extinction. On June 9, 2026, Terrible's stepped in to take over operations from Affinity Gaming, cancelling the planned July 4th permanent closure. As a result, Primm Valley Resort & Casino, the gas stations, and the Lotto Store will all remain open.  This video captures exactly how the resort looked and felt during my visit, before the announcement was made.  Would you stay here?
